preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 3000, inclusive.
The size of the board is between 1 and 1000 cells in each dimension.
The number of white cells on the first and second rows can be between 0 and the size of the board.
The number of white and black dominoes can be between 0 and the number of cells on the board.

postconditions.description: The output is either 'YES' if it's possible to place all dominoes on the board or 'NO' if it's not.
